result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there are a few visual defects: a restaurant title that is clipped mid-character despite available space, horizontally truncated carousel content without ellipsis, and a partially visible category chip at the screen edge.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' section appears clipped mid-character (renders as 'Tokumaru Rameı') even though there is ample empty space between the name and the 4.8 rating on the right.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text container width or truncation logic so the full name renders; if truncation is needed, use a proper ellipsis (…) instead of cutting characters.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' shows a hard-cut title ('Trattoria Piccol') with no ellipsis, making it look broken rather than intentionally truncated by the carousel edge.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis to card titles or add edge fade/peek styling so partially visible carousel items look intentional.

issues.description: A category filter chip at the far right of the chip row is cut off at the screen edge with almost no visible content, giving little affordance that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing so the next chip peeks more visibly (e.g., 30–40% visible) or add a gradient fade to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: Placeholder text in the search field ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on light gray background, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) against the input background.
